comparison.objective: Position a drain pan under an engine before pulling its drain plug; the candidate adjusts a gripper stop.
comparison.physical_skill: Spatial placement followed by plug manipulation while preventing spill, not preserving a stop setting during jam-nut torque.
comparison.success_condition: Pan must cover the drain path before plug removal, with spill/loss failure conditions; candidate grades retained opening angle.
comparison.reason: Any shared threaded plug primitive is subordinate to a different sequencing and containment ability.
